node.title: Re: using "require" problem
node.author: Discipulus
node.doctext:
Hello [gauss76],

Normally you will put your routines into a module: Routines.pm will be the name of the file with inside a [DOC://package|package] called Routines You can use [metacpan://Exporter] to export, possibly just on demand, one or more subs.

Consider also that current directory . is no more included in @INC in newer Perl version for security reasons: you can include it with use lib '.'; (or adding it directly to @INC or using the -I perl switch) PS this is probably unrelated (see [id://1200092|below]) but important to know anyway

Look at my homenode for [href://?node_id=174111#modules|many links] about modules and code reuse: especially [id://1117238] and [id://619554]

L*

There are no rules, there are no thumbs..
Reinvent the wheel, then learn The Wheel; may be one day you reinvent one of THE WHEELS.
